To make retrieval date-aware, store each fact with its evidence, temporal validity interval, and lifecycle state, then exclude invalid or deprecated facts before ranking [8]. You can also encode fact age in representations, apply time-decay during retrieval, and check whether retrieved evidence is still temporally valid before using it [4].

For time-sensitive questions, signal when older evidence stops applying: dates alone may not make models adapt reliably [1]. Use reliable temporal metadata, since date-filtered web search can still leak post-cutoff information [2].
